newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith to spin off US music arm - paper.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith to spin off US music arm - paper.

text.p: UK retail group W.H. Smith Group Plc is in talks to spin off its U.S. music business, The Wall, as part of a wave of rationalisation in the troubled U.S. sector, the Financial Times said.
The retailer is one of three groups in talks about the future of a 350-store music chain called Camelot, which has sought protection from creditors, the newspaper said on Friday.

The newspaper said Smith, which wants to put The Wall into a bigger group and is talking to other music retailers such as Camelot and possibly Musicland Stores Corp, intends to keep an equity stake in any combined group but would cede management control.
John Hancock, the head of Smith's U.S. operations, was quoted as confirming the talks.
"The Wall is not big enough as it stands to be part of the endgame that is being played out," it quoted Hancock as saying.
But he declined to give details.
